lines.en: : HARDER!!!!!!!!!!!!! FUCK MY LITTLE PUSSY ‘TIL I’M OVERFLOWING WITH CUM!!!!!! AAAAAHHHHH! AAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!!
: TSUKASA!!!!! IS IT OVER YET?!?!!!!
: Yes!
: Finally! If Chinami had to listen to another second of that-
: OHHHH FUCK! IT’S SO FUCKING BIG, MASTER! IT’S SO DEEP INSIDE OF ME! CHIKA-CHAN LOVES YOUR COCK MORE THAN ANYTHING IN THE WHOLE, WIDE WORLD!
: AAAAAAHHHHH! YOU LIED TO CHINAMI! NOW, THERE’S NO ONE LEFT FOR HER TO TRUST!
: Could you keep it down over there? I’m trying to study.
: Study?! For what?! We’re still just-
: Wizards, I know. But as wizards, shouldn’t it be our responsibility to absorb all of the world’s secrets and not just the ones our parents want us to?
: Chinami doesn’t have parents! They left her and then died respectively!
: Yes, but you have Jeeves now, don’t you? You’re always calling him Papa. And I’m pretty sure I heard your sister call him “Daddy” a few minutes ago.
: She’s probably not supposed to do that! But Chinami still doesn’t know the rules when it comes to adult things!
: Oh my God...yes! YES! JUST...LIKE THAT! MASTER! I’M...CUMMING! I’M...FUCKING CUMMING! AAAAAH!
: Chinami wishes she was born deaf instead of just almost sick all the time.
: They keep talking about “cumming,” but what does that mean?
: I have discerned that it bears no relevance to transportation whatsoever, and that would imply it’s sexual in nature. But how does one sexually arrive?
: Chinami! Check the Internet! Google “cumming!”
: No! Chinami doesn’t want to look up naughty words because Tsukasa has decided to be a bad girl!
: How? It’s not my fault if I just happen to overhear everything your sister is doing with Jeeves in there. It’s their fault for being so loud.
: Chinami is gonna give them a piece of her mind too! She just...can’t go in there right now for obvious reasons!
: Ooh! What if you say you forgot something?! And we both just run in really quickly to grab it? That way, we could see them up close and-
: And burn our eyes out?! Be blinded for life?!
: Tsk, tsk, Chinami. You must be forgetting that I have already witnessed Jeeves’ “alone time” with another girl.
: I’m practically an expert at this now. I only want to see it again because science must be tested multiple times.
: Right...science.
: Well, of course. Why else would I take any interest in what Jeeves does with your sister?
: Chinami thinks Tsukasa is having an early awakening.
: Am not! Let’s just look up videos instead. I’ve heard of a thing called “pornography” recently that shows men and women-
: Chinami knows what pornography is!
: No you don’t. You’re the innocent and less smart one here. You can’t possibly know something I don’t.
: Chinami knows lots of things about lots of stuff! But she understands that these things are supposed to be “forbidden knowledge” at her age, so she just pretends she doesn’t!
: What’s “cumming” then?
: That one Chinami doesn’t know. But she still thinks you shouldn’t use your computer to find out. Big sis Chika says there’s lots of evil stuff on the Internet.
: There’s lots of evil stuff outside of the Internet too, Chinami. Our chances of being exploited online are exponentially lower. It’s common sense.
: You raise a good point...but don’t you think this is kind of bad? We could get into trouble with the...cyber police.
: Mother says the police won’t do anything about a Tsukioka, so you should be safe so long as it’s on my laptop. I’m not really sure where to start looking, though.
: Like, pornography would obviously need to be hidden so children wouldn’t be able to access it, right? So I doubt just searching for the word would work.
: Maybe...sex videos?
: Chinami thinks that’s still too direct. We might need to be smarter with what we type in.
: Any ideas? We should make it a serious first try. I don’t want my computer getting flagged by the cyber-police even if I can bribe them.
: God, yes! I love it when you fuck me, Daddy! Give it to me! More! More!
: Sister, no! Don’t you know how thin these walls are?! You’re going to burn Chinami’s ears!
: “Boy...fucks...girl.” There. Slang should bypass the filter, right? And I’m pretty sure “fuck” means “sex.” Do you think “cumming” might also be-
: Ah! There it is! Pornhub! I guess the word isn’t banned after all.
: What are we supposed to do now, though? Because it says this website is for people over the age of-
: YOU LIED AGAIN AND CLICKED THE WRONG BUTTON! WHO ARE YOU ALL OF A SUDDEN?!
: Oh, Chinami. You’ll never last in the outside world if you aren’t willing to lie to get the things you want. This is what needed to be done. And you’ll be thanking me shortly.
: There are so many different options, though. Should we just click on one or search for something specific?
: Ch...Chinami will...let Tsukasa choose...
: She’s going to look...the opposite way so her eyes don’t bleed.
: Maybe I’ll just try searching for girls our age? There’s probably something on here that-
: Aren’t you supposed to be smart?! You definitely can’t do that! You’ll get put on some kind of list!
: A list? Like...what kind of list?
: Chinami doesn’t know! That’s why she said “some” kind of list! Just click on one! With adults!
: Fine, jeez. Then how about...oh! Here we go. “Hung Stud Fucks GF’s Little Sister. MASSIVE Cock & LOADS of Cum.” So that’s how it’s spelled.
: Tsukasa...Chinami still thinks this is a bad idea...Big sis Chika will kill both of us if she finds out.
: Stop being a scaredy-cat. Just don’t let her find out and we’ll be fine. Click.
: Aaaah! Chinami is going to Hell if Hell is real! But at least she’ll still be able to see Tsukasa there!
: Chinami, calm down. It’s important that we approach this with some level of civility so we can keep a level head when the time comes for us to-
: OH MY GOD?! WHAT IS THAT?! IT’S GIGANTIC!
: Already?! There wasn’t even any dialogue! Why did they give the movie a title at all?!
: Is that his penis? It’s like six inches long! They can get that big?!
: N...Not that Chinami actually cares or...is interested in any capacity, which she definitely is not — but is that bigger than Papa’s was when you saw it?
: I was kind of far away and I couldn’t really get a good look at it...not like I actually cared or had any interest either, so...maybe? I’m not...sure.
: And you won’t volunteer to go back into your apartment with me, so there is a chance we’ll never know unless your sister tells us for some reason.
: Or if he “fucks” us instead since there’s a clear precedent of that happening based on the title of this movie.
: ABSOLUTELY NOT! NEVER! PAPA WOULDN’T!
: But in the event that he would...would you?
: No! Chinami loves him, but not like that!
: I’m just saying, Chinami, it sounds like your sister is having the time of her life right now. Have you ever felt that good about literally anything ever?
: Probably not! But that doesn’t mean I’m going to do it with my sister’s boyfriend! Who is also kind of my dad!
: You have an older sister too! Are you telling me you’d do it with my Papa if you overheard them?!
: Not if his is as big as that guy’s. That just sounds like it would hurt. This girl seems to be enjoying it, though. And she’s a little sister too, so who knows?
: Ch...Chinami just doesn’t understand why you’re so obsessed with dirty stuff all of a sudden. She misses when we just played games.
: That’s very rude to the actors, Chinami. They worked hard on this. You can tell by how much they’re sweating.
: I still haven’t seen any “cum,” though. Does it just happen on the inside, maybe? Chinami, fetch my notebook. I want to write down some questions I have for Jeeves. He’ll help me.
: Chinami begs you to not ask her Papa any questions about this. You have already made her big sister uncomfortable. He is all I have left.
: Jeeves won’t be uncomfortable answering my questions, though. He’s a teacher.
: And for all we know, those two really are studying in there. Mother always said his methods were unorthodox after all.
: Besides, he’s done it in the same room as me before. And probably made eye contact with me. I think. Who else can I ask?
: Your mom! Like big sis Chika said!
: I can’t.
: Why not?
: Because she’s already trying to arrange a marriage for me. Asking her questions about sex now might make her speed up the process.
: What?
: Oh, the little sister’s on top now. That looks far more comfortable.
: Tsukasa, what did you just say?
: That the little sister is on top and it looks far more comfortable. You’d know that too if you’d just look at the screen and stop being so afraid of normal human functions.
: Not about that...I meant the other thing.
: Oh. Yeah.
: My mom’s trying to set up an arranged marriage. It’s a pretty normal thing in rich families. And it’ll help her get rid of me faster, so...
: Are you serious?
: Mhm. And I’m not sure how old the guy will be yet, but if he’s an adult, I don’t want to be blindsided by not knowing what I’m doing when it comes to all this stuff.
: That’s...the thing you’re worried about? Not...knowing what to do?
: It’s not the only thing. I’m worried about a bunch of stuff. Like if he’s mean. What his house looks like. If I can bring my henchmen.
: This is the one thing I can control, though. So if I know all of this stuff by the time we’re married, it’ll be one less thing to worry about.
: And you’re...okay with this?
: It’s my duty. And...
: The first chance I’ve ever had to be useful.
: But...But you’re Chinami’s age. You can’t get married yet. That’s not legal, she doesn’t think.
: I don’t know the logistics of it. I just know that it’s been happening for hundreds of years and that it’ll continue to happen long after the two of us are gone.
: Why would your mom do that, though? She can’t just...give you away. Why would she give you away? You guys are the richest family in Kumon-mi, aren’t you? What can you gain by-
: Oh, that’s cum! Eww...It looks kind of gross.
: Tsukasa! This is serious!
: I know it’s serious, okay?! But there’s nothing I can do about it! And chances are, I don’t have the answers to 99%% of your questions so please, just drop it!
: There’s nothing you can do?! You can’t say no?! To what happens to your own life?!
: I mean...
: I can.
: But why would I?...
: Onee-sama is the family’s heir. No one in the manor cares about me. And Mother was part of an arranged marriage too when she was younger.
: She’s the most powerful woman in the whole city now...Something I will never be.
: But I need to be something.
: The name “Tsukioka” is far too big for a walking back-up plan like me...
: So maybe a new one will suit me better?
: Wait, why are you crying? You’re not the one who has to marry some random person.
: Because that’s the saddest thing I’ve ever heard! And I’ve heard a lot of sad things, Tsukasa! A lot!
: I don’t doubt that. Your life is pretty horrible compared to mine. And there are tons of people who would jump at the opportunity to marry into some rich family.
: You’re not one of them, though! You don’t actually want this! You’re just doing it because it’s expected of you! And I...Chinami doesn’t think that’s fair!
: Yeah, well...
: Without knowing what I do want...there’s no point trying to fight back against the life that was chosen for me.
: If I can do that right, at least I can contribute something to the family before I’m gone...
: Chinami will find a way...to keep you here.
: She promises...
: She shouldn’t.
: But she does...because she knows this isn’t what Tsukasa wants.
: And she is going to find a way to protect her even if Tsukasa doesn’t want her to.
: On a...brighter note...I think your sister and Jeeves might finally be done? Or at least...taking a break?
: Big sis Chika probably killed him...she’s crazy now and sounded very scary with all of her yelling.
: Well...at least Jeeves died doing what he loved.
: I just wish I got to ask him some of my questions first...
